_comment: skill_range is [orange_ends, yellow_ends, green_ends, grey_at] - WoW's real profession skill-up convention. Below orange_ends: guaranteed skill-up (100%). Between orange_ends and yellow_ends: high chance. Between yellow_ends and green_ends: low chance. At/above grey_at: no skill-up at all - the material has nothing left to teach you. All 4 numbers are against the profession's OWN skill level (0-75 for early tier), not against character level. Common/cheap materials (Peacebloom, Copper, Weakstone) grey out early since they're meant to be quickly outgrown; the pricier/rarer early materials (Mageroyal, Rough Iron) stay relevant closer to the 75 cap.
